nom: Bubble Come Clean Detox Clay Mask

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say clay masks are usually too much for them but this one is gentle and effective, while others, including one who explicitly says her skin is not typically sensitive, report severe burning and redness.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin, including some also acne-prone, generally report the mask controls oil and helps clear their skin well, with several recommending it be used only once or twice a week.
segments.dry: Many reviewers with dry skin say that unlike other clay masks they have tried, this one does not leave their skin feeling dry or tight, several specifically contrasting it with past drying experiences.
segments.combination: Most reviewers with combination skin say it clears clogged pores, especially around the nose and chin, without irritating the rest of the face, though one found it unremarkable for her combination skin specifically.

concerns.redness: A cluster of reviewers, some on a first use, report significant burning and visible redness, in a few cases described as feeling like a chemical or sun burn that took time to calm down, including one who says this happened despite not normally having sensitive skin; many more reviewers, however, say it never irritates their skin at all.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers, including some with oily, acne-prone skin, report clearer skin and faster resolution of breakouts with weekly use; one reviewer, though, says it did not detox her skin as much as she needed.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally say the mask draws out oil effectively and helps control breakouts, recommending use once or twice a week rather than more often.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers say the mask, unlike other clay masks they have tried, leaves skin feeling soft and hydrated rather than tight or dry; a few still describe it as strong enough to require limiting use to once a week.

aspects.libelle: Small amount of product for the price
Comes with a cute application brush

I love the idea of detoxing masks, but I have sensitive skin so clay masks are difficult for me to use and really love. But this mask? This mask is IT. I know that some will complain that it doesn't do "enough" but I have nestled this product perfectly into my lineup to help pull the gunk out if my skin to exfoliate later in the week. No, it won't do any of that crazy drying, cracking, pulling-oil-spots-out-of-your-face stuff, but it is gentle and effective. A great addition to any routine!

I've been using the Bubble Come Clean clay mask for a couple of weeks now, and I really like it. It goes on super smooth and doesn't feel harsh or tight while it dries. After I rinse it off, my skin feels really clean but not dry or stripped. I have dry-combination skin and some clogged pores around my nose and chin, and this actually helps clear it up a bit without irritating the rest of my face. The packaging is very cute! It does have a slight scent, so if you're super sensitive to smells, just something to note. Overall, it's a clay mask that works gently but effectively. I'd recommend it if you're looking for something to refresh your pores without being too harsh. 💕💕💕

i love this mask. recently i've been sweating a lot and it is causing tons of breakouts on my forehead, i used the come clean mask and it really helped! two days after my breakout is gone! not only did the mask get rid of my breakout but also left my skin feeling moisturized which is amazing bc not only do i have dry skin but past clay masks that I have used have always left my skin feeling dry. The packaging is so aesthetically pleasing and I love how the mask comes in a little bubble. Overall I recommend this mask to anyone and everyone:))

I was recommended to use a clay mask for my skin care routine as i have oily, acne prone skin. This product works well. I only use it 1-2 times per week and it works wonders. I would not use it anymore often than twice in a week though.
